sourceAnchors.message: Use ReentrantLock rather than synchronization
sourceAnchors.reason: SS351 requires each supplied observation to be serialized from read through atomic publication. This private monitor coordinates per-owner state and has neither exposed lock selection nor external worker creation. WEBOBXCONN006 verifies no metric publication or second query before the first completes.

sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching Throwable in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: SSC469 retains the JDK try-with-resources contract for every Throwable; the owned scope records and rethrows its exact primary, and the typed close suppresses or rethrows its exact failure. The implementation does not report a successful observation on a failure.
